nodes.text: Back again? Good. The bench was getting cold.
The well's still sweet, the guards still grumble, and the Riftgate still hums. Steady as ever — and steady is a gift, mark me.
Hetty's hens got out twice this week, and Tobbin swears he saw a light over Gloomhollow. Between you and me? Tobbin also swears his scales are honest.
Off you go, dear. These old bones and I have important sitting to do.
